name: flash_attn_012_gqa_paged_decode_baseline
author: flash_attn
description: FlashAttention varlen baseline for GQA paged decode (ps=1)

sources.content:
import math
import torch
from flash_attn import flash_attn_varlen_func


@torch.no_grad()
def run(q, k_cache, v_cache, kv_indptr, kv_indices, sm_scale):
    batch_size, num_qo_heads, head_dim = q.shape
    num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, _ = k_cache.shape

    # For page_size=1, k_cache: [num_pages, 1, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
    # Gather KV using indices to produce ragged KV: [total_kv, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
    k_cache_flat = k_cache.squeeze(1)  # [num_pages, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
    v_cache_flat = v_cache.squeeze(1)

    kv_indices_long = kv_indices.to(torch.long)
    k_gathered = k_cache_flat[kv_indices_long]  # [total_kv, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
    v_gathered = v_cache_flat[kv_indices_long]

    # Q is [batch_size, num_qo_heads, head_dim] - decode (1 token per batch)
    # FlashAttention varlen expects q as [total_q, num_qo_heads, head_dim]
    # For decode, total_q = batch_size, qo_indptr = [0, 1, 2, ..., batch_size]
    qo_indptr = torch.arange(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
    kv_indptr_i32 = kv_indptr.to(torch.int32)

    kv_lens = kv_indptr_i32[1:] - kv_indptr_i32[:-1]
    max_seqlen_k = int(kv_lens.max().item()) if kv_lens.numel() > 0 else 0
    max_seqlen_q = 1

    if max_seqlen_k == 0:
        # No KV at all
        output = torch.zeros((batch_size, num_qo_heads, head_dim), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=q.device)
        lse = torch.full((batch_size, num_qo_heads), -float('inf'), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
        return output, lse

    # Need to handle batches with kv_len=0: FA varlen requires all batches have q tokens
    # but we can still call it - empty kv batches will produce zeros / -inf lse
    # Actually FA will fail if a batch has zero kv. So we filter them out.
    valid_mask = kv_lens > 0

    output = torch.zeros((batch_size, num_qo_heads, head_dim), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=q.device)
    lse = torch.full((batch_size, num_qo_heads), -float('inf'), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)

    if not valid_mask.all():
        # Reconstruct valid-only inputs
        valid_idx = torch.where(valid_mask)[0]
        q_valid = q[valid_idx].contiguous()
        # Build new kv_indptr only for valid batches
        new_kv_indptr = torch.zeros(len(valid_idx) + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
        new_kv_indptr[1:] = kv_lens[valid_idx].cumsum(0)
        qo_indptr_valid = torch.arange(len(valid_idx) + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)

        result = flash_attn_varlen_func(
            q_valid, k_gathered, v_gathered,
            qo_indptr_valid, new_kv_indptr,
            1, max_seqlen_k,
            causal=False,
            softmax_scale=sm_scale,
            return_attn_probs=True,
        )
        out_valid, lse_valid, _ = result
        output[valid_idx] = out_valid
        lse[valid_idx] = lse_valid.transpose(0, 1).contiguous() / math.log(2.0)
    else:
        result = flash_attn_varlen_func(
            q, k_gathered, v_gathered,
            qo_indptr, kv_indptr_i32,
            max_seqlen_q, max_seqlen_k,
            causal=False,
            softmax_scale=sm_scale,
            return_attn_probs=True,
        )
        out_valid, lse_valid, _ = result
        output = out_valid
        lse = lse_valid.transpose(0, 1).contiguous() / math.log(2.0)

    return output, lse
